Janswabhiman Welfare Society

We take personal information about you when you enter a request, sign up to our information sheet or register your interest as a potential volunteer or a donor. The data we gather consist of your name, address, e-mail as well as phone numbers. This personal information is not distributed, shared, rented or given to companies or organizations that are not part of the JSWS group.

We usually update our followers by email, 12 times a year. If you think you are being contacted frequently, please inform us and we can limit this to less updates or if you would prefer, take you out from the e-mailing list completely.
You can also request a copy of the personal info we have for you at any time by emailing at
mailus@janswabhiman.org
. If any personal information changes or you find our records are not up-to-date, please inform us.
We will make sure your personal information is held safely, as per the Data Protection Act.

Disclaimer & Data Privacy Notice
1. About Our Website and Content

Thanks for visiting the Jan Swabhiman Welfare Society website. We use this platform to share our projects, success stories, and educational materials. We honestly do our best to keep everything accurate and current. However, all the information here is shared in good faith just to keep you informed. We try our hardest to keep the website up to date, but we can't make any legal guarantees that absolutely everything is always complete or accurate.
2. Donations and Your Tax Benefits (80G/12A)
We deeply appreciate your financial support; it's entirely voluntary and means the world to our mission.
Your donations are eligible for tax benefits under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

Indian tax laws require us to submit donor information, including your PAN, to the Income Tax Department so we can generate your official Form 10BE. When you donate, you're giving us the green light to handle this mandatory filing on your behalf.
Where Your Money Goes
We make sure every single rupee goes directly toward the charitable work approved under our 12A/12AB registration.

We take your privacy seriously. Because we operate under India's 2023 DPDP Act, Jan Swabhiman acts as your Data Fiduciary. In plain English: we are completely legally and ethically accountable for locking down any personal details you share with us. When you give us your contact info or PAN, you're consenting to let us process it. We promise to only use this data for exactly what's needed: sending your tax receipts, sharing updates on how your money is helping, and fulfilling government audits. You can always ask us to check, update, or delete your information—just keep in mind that the law requires us to hold onto certain tax records for a few years.

Please know that Jan Swabhiman Welfare Society, along with our volunteers and trustees, cannot be held legally responsible for any decisions you make based on the content of this site. You use the website at your own discretion.
5. Cancellations and Refunds

Because we are a non-profit organization, donations generally cannot be refunded once they go through. That said, we know technical glitches happen! In case a technical glitch causes a double charge, just reach out to us within 7 days. We'll verify the error on our end and get that extra payment refunded to you right away.
6. Copyright & Protecting Our Content

The photos of the people we help, our research reports, and the "Jan Swabhiman" logo reflect a lot of hard work and, more importantly, the privacy of our beneficiaries. All of these materials are protected under the Indian Copyright Act, 1957. Please don't copy, reproduce, or distribute our content without getting written permission from our General Secretary first.
7. Legal Jurisdiction
This website and all our policies follow the laws of India. If any legal issues come up regarding this website, they will be settled exclusively in the courts of New Delhi.
